title: Files
summary: Stores uploaded files for other modules (FileClient): streamed to DATA_DIR on disk, type decided from the content (no SVG/HTML), size-capped, hashed; deleted files kept 30 days. An administrator's page lists, downloads, and deletes them.
when_to_use: A module needs uploads: a logo, attachments, scanned documents, photos.
when_not_to_use: Large media (video) or files that must live in object storage/CDN — not in this version.
Public file hosting: modules serve their own files and decide who may see them.

env.name: FILES_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Largest upload in bytes (default 10485760 = 10 MiB, at most 200 MiB). A module may set a smaller limit for its own uploads.
